interface.name: create_category
interface.title: Create Store Category
interface.description: Creates a new product category in the store, optionally nested under an existing parent category.
whenToUse: The merchant explicitly asks to add a new category, e.g. 'create a Winter Sale category'.
The merchant wants a sub-category under a category that already exists, and gave its id.
whenNotToUse: The merchant wants to rename or re-sort an existing category -- use update_category instead.
The merchant is only asking which categories exist -- use list_categories instead.

name.description: The category's display name, at least 3 characters.

parentId.description: Id of the parent category. Omit or pass 0 for a top-level category.

status.description: Whether the new category is visible in the storefront.

parent_id.description: Id of the parent category; 0 for top level.

http.summary: Create Category -- add a new category to the store.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing or does not carry the categories.read_write scope, so nothing was created.
The category was rejected as invalid -- the per-field messages say which value to fix; nothing was created.

dependencies.reason: a parent category id comes from list_categories
